in_sanskrit.name: रोसन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rosan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'रोशन' (Roshan), which means 'bringing light', 'radiant', or 'shining'. In this context, Rosan could be interpreted as 'Radiant Rose'.

in_hindi.name: रोसन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Rosan in Hindi is derived from the Hindi word 'रोस' (Ros), which is derived from the English word 'Rose'. It retains the same meaning of 'Rose' in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: ரோசன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Rosan in Tamil could be derived from the Tamil word 'ரோசம்' (Rosam), which means 'joy' or 'happiness'. In this context, Rosan could be interpreted as 'Joyful Rose'.

in_telugu.name: రొసన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Rosan in Telugu could be derived from the Telugu word 'రొశ్య' (Rosy), which is derived from the English word 'Rose'. It retains the same meaning of 'Rose' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Rosan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rosan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rasayana', meaning 'a healing remedy'. The name Rosan is a diminutive form of 'Rosy', which is derived from the name 'Rose'. The name is a symbol of beauty, grace, and gentleness. It represents the fragrant and delicate nature of a rose flower.
